title: PUMA Official Website
text: My work on PUMA’s brand website combined Flash development and animation with design and concept work. Campaign content and product stories sat within a visual interface that reflected the brand’s sport and lifestyle focus. The archived version includes featured campaigns, product imagery, and downloadable wallpapers, with navigation between different areas of the site. This was a Flash-based version of PUMA.com, where motion and interactive presentation were part of the browsing experience. My contribution covered both development and creative work on that historical site.
summary: My work on PUMA’s brand website combined Flash development, animation, design, and concept work, bringing product stories and campaign content into an interactive browsing experience.
